visual_brief.subject: Meta puts agent data rules where the data is read
verified_context: Meta describes PrivacyLib as a common client-side privacy layer used across many internal systems.
For supported internal-agent paths, AgentLib propagates agent-session and tool-call context to PrivacyLib, where policy modules can observe or deny data access.
The architecture and scale claims are first-party and do not prove that every internal system or agent path is covered.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: The decisive control belongs at the stable data boundary, not inside the agent's instructions.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A layered stone archive is crossed by one dark-metal access channel whose terracotta gate is physically anchored into the archive boundary.
must_show: gate fixed at the data boundary

candidate_notes.A: The front cutaway clearly suggests an archive and enforcement point, but the bilateral channel can read as two flows rather than one access path.
candidate_notes.B: The three-quarter cutaway strongly shows a channel entering storage, though the large foreground rail dominates compact crops.
candidate_notes.C: Selected: one dark channel crosses one terracotta collar fixed exactly at the layered archive boundary. The relationship stays explicit and balanced in every required crop.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 21:9 center crop preserves the single channel, terracotta collar, boundary and layered archive interior.
crop_review.article_mobile: The complete control-at-boundary relationship remains visible in 16:9.
crop_review.square: The square crop removes empty approach space while retaining the channel, collar and archive layers.
crop_review.thumbnail: At approximately 320px wide, the dark channel and terracotta collar remain an unmistakable focal pair.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared all candidates with the declared references for architectural cutaway depth, matte pale-stone mass, restrained terracotta/charcoal contrast and compact silhouette. C provides the closest brand fit and clearest story-specific control boundary.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Codex model self-review of three full-size candidates, two declared golden references, a reference-above-candidates comparison and desktop/mobile/square/thumbnail crops. The canonical Playwright contact-sheet renderer could not install Chromium in this environment, so ImageMagick produced the equivalent comparison sheet; repository validation remains authoritative.
